narrative.overview:
The docs are the bench a developer keeps beside the editor: a quiet neutral grey room, the page laid on one rounded panel, near-black type, and one lilac accent that marks where you are. The layout is Fumadocs' Spacious layout, the same one fumadocs.dev uses: the sidebar sits directly on the ground and the page floats in a bordered, rounded panel beside it. The type, the logo, and the accent come from copilotkit.ai (CopilotKit/website) and the copilotkit-branding skill. Every background stays neutral; that is a binding call from the docs owner and it overrides the website's pale-lavender surface.

The system is a token layer, not a fork. Every brand decision lives in `src/app/theme.css`: a few `--color-fd-*` variables (text greys and the accent) over the untouched neutral preset, Tailwind font and radius tokens, and some base-layer browser surfaces. The only other touchpoints are documented Fumadocs options: the Spacious layout import, its stylesheet in `global.css`, the nav title, and `className` on the page-action buttons. A Fumadocs upgrade should need nothing beyond checking that `theme.css` still maps onto the variables it ships.

The mood is calm, technical, and spacious. There is no decoration: no glows, gradients, or tinted fields.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey ground and panel (achromatic in light and dark), near-black ink.
One accent, lilac ink, carried by Fumadocs' `primary` (active nav, tabs, TOC, link underlines, focus rings).
Plus Jakarta Sans for everything read; Spline Sans Mono for code and buttons.
The Spacious layout: sidebar on the ground, the page in a 24px-rounded panel.
Light and dark themes both supported; the system follows the reader's OS setting.

rules.name: The Neutral Ground Rule
rules.body: Every background and surface is achromatic grey, white, or black, in both themes. No tinted grounds, washes, glows, or gradients. Brand color never fills a region; it marks state.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lilac ink is the only accent. Anything Fumadocs marks as "active" or "focused" gets it through `--color-fd-primary`; nothing else is colored. Callout colors appear only inside callouts.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Colors change in `theme.css` variables and nowhere else. If a Fumadocs component looks wrong, fix the variable it reads; never add a selector that restyles the component.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Spline Sans Mono appears only on code, code-like text, and buttons. Never for paragraphs, headings, or labels a person reads as prose.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans is always sentence case. No all-caps headings or labels.

rules.name: The Flat Room Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from neutral tone steps and hairlines, never from color, glow, or glass.

dos: Do keep every background and surface achromatic: grey, white, or black.
Do change the theme in `src/app/theme.css` by editing `--color-fd-*`, `--font-*`, or `--radius-*` values.
Do use Fumadocs' built-in components (Cards, Callout, Tabs, Steps, code blocks, TOC, search) before building anything custom.
Do use the official logo component at 28px tall or more, with clear space around it of half its height.
Do check new accent uses against 4.5:1 on the ground, the frame, and the 10% lilac-ink tint.
Do keep Spline Sans Mono for code and buttons only.
donts: Don't tint a background: no lavender, cream, or colored grounds, washes, glows, or gradients.
Don't restyle a Fumadocs component with a selector (`#nd-sidebar a { … }`, `.prose h2 { … }`). Change the token it reads, or use a prop Fumadocs documents.
Don't add a second accent color, gradient text, glass panels, or blur circles.
Don't redraw, recolor, or rebuild the CopilotKit logo; use `CopilotKitLogo`.
Don't put headings or labels in all caps, or set prose in mono.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings.
